text:
Cutter Gauthier is the biggest story in Anaheim and one of the biggest in the league: 23 goals in 25 games, a goal streak that made history before Scott Wedgewood and the Avalanche ended it, and a spot at the top of the Rocket Richard race beside Leon Draisaitl.

Our numbers love the shooter and doubt the pace. The chances are elite and real: 11.8 expected goals on his own shots, a heavy release in the 98th percentile for top speed, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 99th percentile for chances from in front of the net last season. He is on the ice for 89% of Anaheim's power-play time now, up from 55%, which is why 18 of his 32 points come with the man advantage.

But he is shooting 22% against 14% last season, and he has 11 more goals than his chances. That rate rarely lasts, and we flag him as due to cool. Even so, our season-end range is 52 to 71 goals. At 22, on a $13.5 million deal through 2032, a regression to merely great would still make the Flyers wince.
headline: Cutter Gauthier is shooting the lights out
